neighbours.label: the token right before an expected 'period' or 'era' (interwar | post-Soviet | in the ... period), in any language; the - pole is the other side: 'during this time' / 'at the start' (time, not period)
fire: Unemployment soared across Europe during the interwar period of the 1930s.
Church life changed greatly in the post-Soviet period after 1991.
The drug should not be used during the breastfeeding period without advice.
Many castles were built in the late medieval period in this region.
Historians describe the Victorian era as one of rapid industrial change.
Fossils from the Jurassic period were found in the quarry.
Prices stayed flat throughout the postwar period in most countries.
Ceramics from the Ming dynasty period are on display upstairs.

The drug should not be used by children without a doctor's advice.
